clv.definition: Observed CLV = net revenue (NMV - valid refunds) per active customer over Jan-2024..Jun-2025

on_time.definition: Delivered within 5 days of order date (median 4 days; 5 days covers ~3/4 of deliveries)

high_sales_high_return.rule: top-quartile net revenue AND return rate >= 2x overall, min 30 delivered lines
